comment_correction.before:
/** * GT6-style nuclear fuel rod with NBT. * *

Each fuel rod stores: fuel type (enum), remaining health (0 = depleted), * and enrichment level. These are inserted into reactor cores. Unlike the old * 1x1 core which used bare {@link MaterialPrefix#stick} items, fuel rods carry * the state needed for neutron flux simulation and breeding.

*/
comment_correction.after:
/** * Fuel-rod block item backed by a shared reactor definition when available. * *

Reactor execution reads remaining life and moderation from stack data through * {@code RodPhysics}. The {@code FuelType} constructor and health keys remain for * legacy port content. Compatibility-only items without a definition are not * accepted by the current reactor cores.

*/
comment_correction.reason: Remove false bare-stick original-core and enrichment-state claims; describe actual definition-backed execution and legacy fields.
